name: Lathika V
subject: Internship & Job Opportunities
message:
Hello! Thank you for visiting my portfolio.

I am currently pursuing my Computer Science and Engineering degree and actively looking for internship opportunities in Full Stack Development, Data Science, and related technology fields.

I am interested in learning, working on real-world projects, and improving my technical skills. If you have any internship opportunities, job openings, project collaborations, or suggestions, please feel free to contact me.

Thank you for your time and consideration!
